features: 100W High-Power Charging Support : Designed to support charging up to 100W with compatible devices and chargers, providing a convenient solution for high-speed charging and everyday power needs.

USB-A to Type-C Cable : Features a USB-A connector on one end and a USB Type-C connector on the other, making it suitable for compatible OnePlus devices and USB-A charging adapters, power banks and ports.
WARP/Dash Charging Compatible : Designed for use with compatible OnePlus WARP/Dash charging setups. Charging speed depends on the connected charger, device and supported charging protocol.
Wide OnePlus Compatibility : Compatible with a range of OnePlus Type-C smartphones including OnePlus 13, 13R, 13S, 12R, 11R, 10R, 10T, 10, 10 Pro, 9 and other compatible Type-C devices.
Durable Everyday Construction : Made for regular daily charging with a flexible cable body and reinforced connector areas to help withstand repeated use, bending and plugging.
Secure Type-C Connection : Precision-designed Type-C connector provides a stable connection with compatible devices for convenient charging and data transfer.
Charging and Data Transfer : Suitable for everyday charging as well as compatible USB data-transfer applications when connected to a supported device and USB-A port.

Ideal for Home, Office and Travel : A practical replacement or additional charging cable for use with compatible wall chargers, power banks, laptops, desktops and other USB-A equipped charging sources.
